name: Fire Tornado
description: A towering firenado — a spinning column of flame roaring skyward, shedding embers
preview_html:
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>*{margin:0;padding:0}body{overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block}</style></head><body><script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script><script>(function(){
var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
var renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(W,H);renderer.setClearColor(0x0e0603);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
var scene=new THREE.Scene();
var camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55,W/H,0.1,100);
camera.position.set(0,1.7,6);camera.lookAt(0,1.6,0);
function ADD(m){scene.add(m);return m;}
function GLOW(c,o){return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:c,transparent:true,opacity:o,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false});}
function PTS(n,size,extra){var p=new Float32Array(n*3),c=new Float32Array(n*3),g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(c,3));var m=new THREE.PointsMaterial(Object.assign({size:size,vertexColors:true,transparent:true,opacity:0.9,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false},extra||{}));var pts=ADD(new THREE.Points(g,m));return {p:p,c:c,g:g,m:m,pts:pts,up:function(){g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;g.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;}};}
function BOLT(seg,col,op){var arr=new Float32Array((seg+1)*3),g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr,3));var ln=ADD(new THREE.Line(g,new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:op,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false})));return {ln:ln,arr:arr,seg:seg};}
function jag(b,ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,amp){var s=b.seg;for(var k=0;k<=s;k++){var f=k/s,mid=(k>0&&k<s)?amp:0;b.arr[k*3]=ax+(bx-ax)*f+(Math.random()-0.5)*mid;b.arr[k*3+1]=ay+(by-ay)*f+(Math.random()-0.5)*mid;b.arr[k*3+2]=az+(bz-az)*f+(Math.random()-0.5)*mid;}b.ln.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;renderer.setSize(W,H);camera.aspect=W/H;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();});

var N=360,S=PTS(N,0.12,{opacity:0.85}),ta=new Float32Array(N),th=new Float32Array(N),ts=new Float32Array(N),tw=new Float32Array(N),tm=new Float32Array(N);
function seed(i){ta[i]=Math.random()*6.283;th[i]=Math.random()*3.2;ts[i]=0.1+Math.random()*0.07;tw[i]=Math.random()*0.25;tm[i]=2.6+Math.random()*0.8;}
for(var i=0;i<N;i++)seed(i);
var coreM=ADD(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.1,0.28,3.2,14,1,true),GLOW(0xffd070,0.3)));coreM.position.y=1.6;
var EN=60,E=PTS(EN,0.08),ea=new Float32Array(EN),eh=new Float32Array(EN),er=new Float32Array(EN);
for(var i=0;i<EN;i++){ea[i]=Math.random()*6.283;eh[i]=Math.random()*3.2;er[i]=0.3+Math.random()*1.2;E.c[i*3]=1;E.c[i*3+1]=0.5;E.c[i*3+2]=0.1;}
var t=0;function animate(){requestAnimationFrame(animate);t+=0.02;
  for(var i=0;i<N;i++){ta[i]+=ts[i];th[i]+=0.035;if(th[i]>tm[i])seed(i),th[i]=0;var f=th[i]/tm[i],rad=0.12+th[i]*0.34+tw[i]*Math.sin(t*4+ta[i]);S.p[i*3]=Math.cos(ta[i])*rad;S.p[i*3+1]=0.05+th[i];S.p[i*3+2]=Math.sin(ta[i])*rad;S.c[i*3]=1;S.c[i*3+1]=Math.max(0.15,0.85-f*0.7);S.c[i*3+2]=Math.max(0.02,0.4-f*0.5);}
  S.up();coreM.rotation.y+=0.05;coreM.material.opacity=0.24+0.1*Math.sin(t*8);
  for(var i=0;i<EN;i++){eh[i]+=0.03;ea[i]+=0.02;if(eh[i]>3.4){eh[i]=0;er[i]=0.3+Math.random()*1.2;}E.p[i*3]=Math.cos(ea[i])*er[i];E.p[i*3+1]=0.1+eh[i];E.p[i*3+2]=Math.sin(ea[i])*er[i];}
  E.g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
  renderer.render(scene,camera);}
animate();})();</script></body></html>
